known_limitations: The provider exposes no speed/pitch controls, so pacing is provider-default; the owner's 'older/slower' style request cannot be executed through this adapter and would need re-recording or a different provider.

Captions in the preview follow beat timing, not the measured sub-scene silence boundaries; exact subtitle-in/out refinement belongs to CP-10.
